description: PSD is a parallel finite-element solver for continuum dynamics and solid mechanics. The JOSS paper describes fault-to-site earthquake simulations, nonlinear material behaviour and large meshes. The own repository and Readme.MD describe static and dynamic models built with FreeFEM and PETSc and report Apache-2.0. Spatial coverage is the user-defined structure, site or earthquake domain; temporal coverage is the loading or simulated seismic event. A modeller could evaluate ground motion and structural response for infrastructure hazard scenarios. A caveat is that mesh, constitutive law, boundary conditions and earthquake source assumptions govern the result. A successful large parallel run is not independent validation of a particular structure. The code needs substantial solver dependencies and computing resources. No directly related catalogue record was established. The article and own repository were read without compiling or running the solver.
